response.sql:
WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT ID, COUNT(*) as record_count
  FROM Examination
  WHERE ID IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ID
),
shares AS (
  SELECT
    record_count,
    record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () as share
  FROM grouped
),
average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM shares
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT
    record_count,
    share
  FROM shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share)
)
SELECT
  AVG(record_count) as avg_record_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share) - (SELECT avg_share FROM average_share) as avg_excess
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: If no groups have a share exceeding the overall average share, the result is an empty set; the request's phrasing 'return one row' describes the expected case but does not require a row when no groups qualify.
